features.name: Business Foundation
features.description: A new horizontal layer positioned between the base application and system application containing functionally coherent modules for general ERP concepts. Developed with zero depth and includes capabilities like number series management, address management, currency management, and dimension management.
caveats: No localizations planned for business foundation modules; localizations will be built as extensions
Business foundation is just beginning with number series module as the first example

features.name: Number Series Module
features.description: The first module launched within the business foundation. Chosen because it has high uptake across the product, is not too big or too small, and serves as a starting point for the modularization effort. Developed as true open source with 246 community conversations and 250 commits.
caveats: This is the first module in the business foundation; others are planned but not yet released

features.name: Non-breaking Table Movement Between Apps
features.description: A new capability introduced in 2024 wave 1 that allows tables to be moved between apps without requiring upgrade code or causing dependent apps to break. This was a prerequisite for the business foundation modularization effort.
caveats: This only applies to table movement; other breaking changes may still occur

features.name: Application Redirection
features.description: A technical solution that groups logical layers under an application umbrella, allowing objects to move between apps within the application without requiring dependent apps to update their dependencies.
caveats: This was introduced in earlier releases before 2024 wave 1

features.name: Deprecation Scheme
features.description: A formal process for communicating when features or APIs will be removed or changed, allowing partners to plan their updates accordingly.
caveats: Deprecation is treated as a last resort due to the work it imposes on partners

features.name: System Application
features.description: A logical layer introduced several years before 2024 wave 1 as a collection of small modules combining into a new layer. It addressed the original monolithic architecture of Dynamics NAV by breaking functionality into smaller, functionally coherent modules.
caveats: System application itself introduced breaking changes when first released
The system application model is being refined with new capabilities like the business foundation

features.name: Module Architecture and Design Pattern
features.description: A design pattern for building coherent, encapsulated features with stable APIs. Modules separate concerns, hide implementation details via access modifiers, expose stable facades with XML documentation, and support SOLID principles like single responsibility and open-closed principle.
caveats: Individual versioning and effective upgrading for modules are prepared for but not yet implemented

features.name: Number Series Page UI Enhancements
features.description: New features on the Number Series page including open lines fact box, relationship fact box, promoted actions, and ability to see expiring number series that have no open lines or are in warning state.

features.name: Actionable Error Messages for Number Series
features.description: New API provides actionable error messages that allow users to directly navigate to and fix number series issues without leaving their current context. Demonstrated with customer creation when number series has reached its limit.

features.name: New Number Series API (Codeunit-based)
features.description: Redesigned API split into two main codeunits: Number Series codeunit for standard operations (get next number, peek next number, get last number used) and Number Series Batch codeunit for high-performance batch operations. Replaces confusing legacy implementation with multiple similar function names.
caveats: Old legacy API remains functional until version 27 for backwards compatibility

features.name: Number Series Implementation Enum and Interface
features.description: Extensibility mechanism allowing custom number series implementations. Developers can add custom implementations via Number Series Implementation enum that conforms to a simple interface with peek next number, get next number, get last number used, and gaps indication methods.

features.name: Backwards Compatibility for Number Series API
features.description: Old legacy number series code has been obsoleted with version 24 and will be removed in version 27. No breaking changes; old functionality remains operational during the transition period. Microsoft has already converted all internal code to use the new API.
caveats: Deprecated - will be removed in version 27

features.name: Simulate Get Next Number
features.description: Functionality to simulate the next number in a sequence without modifying the state, useful for calculating what the next document number should be.

features.name: Number Series Batch Processing Simplification
features.description: Simplified batch processing that eliminates the previous limitation of 100 number series in cache and handles line changes and date changes automatically.
caveats: Previous implementation had 100 number series limitation

features.name: Copilot Support for Number Series Module
features.description: Community-contributed copilot support for the new number series module being developed by MVP Dimitri Catson, with pull requests and discussion available on GitHub issue 659.

features.name: Componentization of Base Application
features.description: Ongoing effort to break down the base application into modular components, with future modules to be determined and developed on GitHub.
